title: Storm Queen Over Ruins
description: A majestic female warrior with long flowing white hair and a glowing crown stands on a levitating stone platform above a flooded ruined city. She wields a glowing blue energy spear while military fighter jets streak through a dramatic stormy sky around her, with blue magical energy swirling throughout the scene.
